chargers.description: Connector type & power are provisioned by Admin — read-only. You can edit names, zone labels, and status. Click a Charge Point row to view details.

panel.idHelp: Unique device ID — cannot be changed.
panel.zonePlaceholder: E.g. Near the entrance, row B
panel.zoneHelp: Shown to drivers on the station detail page.
panel.operHelp: Toggle status to pause charging during maintenance or station closure.
panel.operLocked: Charge point is not active or suspended by Admin; operational status cannot be changed.

staff.title: Station Staff
staff.subtitle: Assign and manage operational staff directly assigned to your charging stations.

assign.title: Assign Staff Member
assign.help: Enter the user's email to verify account. If eligible, staff permissions for the selected station take effect immediately.

lookup.notFoundHelp: This email is not registered yet. Please instruct the staff member to download the app or register on ChargeOps before assigning them.
lookup.selfAssignmentHelp: You are the owner of this station and cannot assign yourself as station staff.
lookup.alreadyAssignedHelp: This user currently holds an active assignment at another station (or this station). Each staff member can only be assigned to one station at a time.
lookup.roleNotAllowedHelp: This account holds an Admin or Owner role and cannot be assigned as station staff.
lookup.accountInactiveHelp: This account is currently suspended on the platform and cannot be assigned tasks.

revokeModal.title: Revoke Staff Access
revokeModal.warning: Are you sure you want to revoke staff access for {{name}} at {{station}}?
revokeModal.consequence: Once revoked, this staff member will immediately lose access to the operational console, live bookings, connector controls, and station tickets.
revokeModal.auditNote: Historical operational activity and resolved tickets remain preserved for auditing purposes.

matrix.title: Staff Permission Matrix
matrix.help: Station staff hold an operational subset of permissions. Business, revenue, and pricing settings remain exclusive to the Station Owner.

rows.viewStation: View station details, live bookings, connector status
rows.handleTickets: Handle and reply to station support tickets

list.title: Staff Members
list.empty: No staff assigned yet. Enter an email in the form on the left to assign a staff member.
list.noSearchResult: No staff members match the filter criteria.
list.revokeNote: Revoking removes station operational access only — the user's personal driver account, charging history, and credentials remain completely intact.

statusDialog.offlineBodyDevice: This charge point has {{count}} connector(s). Taking the device offline takes every one of them down with it.
statusDialog.offlineBodyConnector: This connector will stop serving drivers. Other connectors on the same charge point are unaffected.
statusDialog.impactNoBookings: No new bookings can be made on the affected connector(s).
statusDialog.impactHiddenFromDrivers: They disappear from driver search and map results.
statusDialog.impactRestores: Each connector's own status is remembered — bringing it back online restores exactly what you set before.
statusDialog.onlineBodyDevice: {{returning}} of {{total}} connector(s) will start accepting bookings again.
statusDialog.onlineBodyConnector: This connector will start accepting bookings again and reappear in driver search.
statusDialog.staysOfflineHint: {{count}} connector(s) stay offline because you disabled them individually. Turn them back on from their own status control.
statusDialog.blockedBodyDevice: {{count}} booking(s) on this charge point are still Confirmed or Checked-In. Under system operational rules, the device cannot go offline while a paid booking is live — the driver may already be plugged in.
statusDialog.blockedBodyConnector: {{count}} booking(s) on this connector are still Confirmed or Checked-In. Under system operational rules, it cannot go offline while a paid booking is live — the driver may already be plugged in.
statusDialog.blockedHint: Wait until these bookings reach a final state, or cancel them from the Bookings screen first.

card.none: No connectors provisioned on this charge point yet.
card.deviceDown: Charge point is {{status}} — none of its connectors can accept bookings until it is back online.
card.pendingActivation: Charge point is Pending Activation — none of its connectors can accept bookings until initial activation.
card.lockedByDevice: Bring the charge point back online to change this connector's status.

panel.qrHelp: Affix onto this connector for drivers to scan on arrival.

pricing.title: Pricing & Hours
pricing.subtitle: Base price, TOU rate windows, and operating hours. Changes only apply to new bookings.
pricing.saveSuccess: Saved pricing and operating hour configurations

step1.title: Basic Config
step1.groupHelp: Drivers can choose any start time (e.g. 09:51). Duration options step by the minimum amount (e.g. 30m → ends at 10:21).
step1.basePriceHelp: This price applies to any hours not covered by a custom TOU rate window below.

step2.title: Operating Hours
step2.helpText: Operating hours affect your station's visibility on the drivers' search map.

step3.title: TOU pricing
step3.noRules: No rate windows defined — every booking uses the base price. Click Add rate window to start.
step3.tipText: Raising the rate for the 18:00 – 21:00 window could lift monthly revenue by up to 15%.

step4.title: Availability & Operational Standards
step4.lockDesc: System automatically cancels holding and releases connector after 15 mins if driver does not check in on time.
step4.advanceDesc: Only accepts reservations for Today and Tomorrow (~48 hours) to ensure schedule predictability.
step4.validConfigHelp: All operational policies are standardized across the platform according to ChargeOps SLA.

confirmModal.title: Confirm Pricing & Hours Configuration
confirmModal.subtitle: Please review the updated configuration parameters before applying them to your station.

addRule.title: Add rate window
addRule.subtitle: Define a custom rate that applies to bookings falling in this window.
addRule.validationError: Please input a valid rule name, price, and time window (HH:mm).

revenue.title: Revenue

stations.emptySearch: No stations matched your search query.
stations.emptyFilter: No stations found with the selected status.

card.pendingHelp: Submission is pending admin review. Station is not visible to drivers yet.

register.title: Register New Station
register.subtitle: Submission remains in PENDING status until evaluated by an administrator.
register.nameHelp: This name is shown to drivers searching on the map.
register.addressHelp: Used to pin your station accurately on the search map.
register.contactPhoneRequired: Please enter a valid contact phone number.
register.licenseHelp: Business licenses are verified off-platform prior to approval (do not upload files here).

amenitiesModal.title: Station amenities
amenitiesModal.subtitle: Choose what {{name}} offers — drivers see these on the station page.
amenitiesModal.hint: These amenities appear on the station detail page in the driver app.

timeline.title: Approval Timeline: {{name}}
timeline.noHistory: No status history recorded for this station yet.

license.title: Operating License
license.subtitle: Track the validity and subscription status of your charging stations.
license.helpBody: Purchasing/renewing licenses is handled off-platform; statuses are recorded by administrators on the system. This page tracks subscription validity.
license.warningBody: When the license expires or is suspended, the station and chargers will be hidden from driver searches until renewed.
